1,552 likes, 108 comments - airbnb on October 30, 2026: "Your next stay on Airbnb helps provide free short-term housing to people affected by disaster, illness, or crisis. Airbnb now donates $0.10 USD per stay to Airbnb.org. This will help contribute $500 million USD to Airbnb.org over the next 5 years, putting us on the path to providing 1 million nights of free emergency housing per year by 2030.

Learn more at the link in bio.".
